mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.4% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 2.4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market recovery, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above historical averages signals robust economic activity, driving investor optimism and higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of elevated GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate below 4.0% creates a dual easing environment, synergistically lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: concurrent monetary and labor market easing
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS < 2.4% and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high GDP growth (GDPC1) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL), investors anticipate sustained growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly positive during periods meeting the late-cycle criteria (GDPC1 > 200 and CPIAUCSL < 2.0).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening supply chain activity, prompting investors to anticipate demand recovery and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and rising retail sales (PAYEMS) below 150,000 indicates dual easing, amplifying equity market optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS < 2.4 and PAYEMS < 150000.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession labor market recovery phase (UNRATE < 5.0%), falling unemployment rates signal strengthening employment conditions, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below 5.0% in the post-recession labor recovery regime.
